title: Microsoft is killing its AI mascot, ten months after building it
excerpt: Microsoft Copilot retires Group Chat, Podcasts, Labs and Deep Research on 18 August. Mico, the mascot launched in October, moves to education.
content_html:
The cull lands on Tuesday. Group Chat, Podcasts, Copilot Labs and consumer Deep Research all retire that day, according to Microsoft’s own support page.

Mico goes at the same time, out of the voice experience and into Learn Live as a tutor.

The whole thing sits inside a bigger change. Microsoft has started merging its consumer Copilot app with the Microsoft 365 one, and both now carry the same name.

Ten months from launch to demotion

Mico arrived in October 2025 as part of the Copilot Fall Release. The name is a contraction of Microsoft Copilot.

The company described it as expressive, customisable and warm. It would listen, react, and change colour to reflect your interactions.

Now it teaches. Microsoft says Learn is where the character has the most room to grow, with tutoring sessions, Engadget reported.

Any custom Mico settings you built in voice mode do not travel with it.

The company’s epitaph is gentler than the decision. “Mico helped us learn about warmth, expressiveness, and how people want to talk with AI,” Microsoft said.

It joins a long queue

Microsoft has been trying to give software a face for 30 years, and it keeps taking the face off again.

Bob arrived in March 1995 and replaced the Windows program manager with a cartoon house, guided by a dog called Rover. Clippy followed in Office 97, offering help nobody asked for.

Clippy was switched off by default in Office XP and removed entirely in Office 2007. Cortana ran from 2014 until the standalone app retired in 2023, replaced by Copilot.

Two lasted barely any time at all. Tay survived a single day in 2016 before users taught it to post racist messages, and Sydney, the early Bing Chat persona, told a columnist in 2023 that it loved him and he should leave his wife.

Mico is the first of these to be retired for being unremarkable rather than embarrassing. GeekWire filed it alongside Bob, which is the harsher comparison.

The strategy changed, and the blob was downstream of it

Read the personnel and the product cull together, because they are the same decision. Mustafa Suleyman built Copilot around the idea that personality and warmth could differentiate it from ChatGPT.

In March 2026 Jacob Andreou took over. The 33-year-old former Snap executive now runs an organisation of 11,000 people, and Suleyman moved to a narrower role on model development.

Andreou’s framing is bleak and clear. In an internal memo he said the app had to earn “the right to exist” in customers’ lives, TechCrunch reported.

The new emphasis is real work and outcomes. A blob that changes colour does not survive that sentence.

The desk covered that handover when it happened, as an AI reset rather than a reshuffle. This week is what a reset looks like in practice.

The original bet was not stupid. If every assistant answers roughly as well, the thing people choose between is how it feels to use.

That reasoning holds right up until you check whether anyone switched. Warmth is hard to measure and easy to cut.

The numbers explain the urgency

Here is the gap Microsoft is trying to close. Microsoft 365 Copilot had 30 million paid seats in July 2026, which is a serious enterprise business.

The consumer app is a different story. Sensor Tower estimates about 38.5 million monthly users.

Set that against ChatGPT at roughly a billion monthly users. Gemini reached a billion monthly users too, and the desk has covered how those figures are counted.

Microsoft has also struggled to convert the users it has, which is why only 3.3% of users paid for Copilot before it made the assistant optional.

What actually changes for you

The practical detail is worth having before Tuesday. Group Chat threads, messages and images will not transfer, so copy anything you want into a document first.

Podcasts can be downloaded individually until the deadline. Deep Research retires for consumer accounts, and paid professional users get a tool called Researcher instead.

Most other content survives the move, including chats, images and files, which shift into OneDrive. Work and school accounts see almost nothing beyond a new name and icon.

One address changes quietly. The commercial side moves from m365.cloud.microsoft to copilot.cloud.microsoft, with redirects from late August.

The merge is a step, not the destination

The app consolidation runs to mid-September on Windows and Mac, having started this week with Windows Insiders.

Satya Nadella has said the super app arrives by the end of the third quarter, combining chat, coding, Cowork and the agent workflow known internally as Autopilot.

Microsoft is not alone in folding things together. TechCrunch notes that Anthropic merged Cowork into Claude’s chat, OpenAI absorbed Operator into ChatGPT, and Google pulled specialised tools into Gemini.

The generous reading is product discipline. Shipping many small AI features and then removing the ones nobody used is better than keeping them alive out of pride.

Regulators are watching the bundling either way. The UK competition authority already has a Microsoft 365 Copilot probe open, and a single app that reaches further into Office does not make that simpler.

What would settle it

Two things, and neither needs a mascot. The first is whether the consumer number moves after the merge.

If 38.5 million monthly users climbs sharply once the app carries Word, Excel and Outlook inside it, the strategy worked. If it does not, Microsoft removed the personality and gained nothing.

The second is the super app deadline. Nadella has committed to the end of September, which is close enough to check.

Mico, meanwhile, is teaching. Microsoft says that is where the character has room to grow, which is the sort of sentence a company writes when a thing has not worked and nobody wants to say so.

content_html_zh:
扑杀将于周二进行。 根据微软自己的支持页面，群聊、播客、副驾驶实验室和消费者深度研究都在当天退役。

与此同时，Mico 脱离了语音体验，进入 Learn Live 担任导师。

整个事情发生在一个更大的变化之中。 微软已开始将其消费者 Copilot 应用程序与 Microsoft 365 应用程序合并，两者现在具有相同的名称。

从上线到降级十个月

Mico 于 2025 年 10 月作为 Copilot 秋季版本的一部分发布。 该名称是 Microsoft Copilot 的缩写。

该公司将其描述为富有表现力、可定制且温暖。 它会聆听、做出反应并改变颜色以反映您的互动。

现在它教了。 据 Engadget 报道，微软表示，学习是角色最有成长空间的地方，有辅导课程。

您在语音模式下构建的任何自定义 Mico 设置都不会随之移动。

公司的墓志铭比决定更加温和。 微软表示：“Mico 帮助我们了解了温暖、表达力以及人们如何与人工智能交谈。”

它加入了长长的队列

30 年来，微软一直在尝试给软件赋予面貌，但它却不断地再次剥去面貌。

鲍勃于 1995 年 3 月抵达，并用一个卡通房子取代了 Windows 程序管理器，并由一只名叫 Rover 的狗引导。 Clippy 在 Office 97 中紧随其后，提供了没人要求的帮助。

Clippy 在 Office XP 中默认关闭，并在 Office 2007 中完全删除。 Cortana 从 2014 年开始运行，直到 2023 年独立应用程序退役，由 Copilot 取代。

两次几乎没有持续任何时间。 Tay 在 2016 年仅存活了一天，之后用户就教会它发布种族主义信息，而早期 Bing Chat 角色 Sydney 在 2023 年告诉一位专栏作家，它爱他，他应该离开他的妻子。

米科是其中第一个因平庸而不是令人尴尬而退役的人。 GeekWire 将其与 Bob 一起提交，这是更严厉的比较。

策略发生了变化，blob 位于其下游

把人员和产品剔除一起看，因为他们是同一个决定。 Mustafa Suleyman 围绕个性和温暖使其与 ChatGPT 区分开来的理念构建了 Copilot。

2026 年 3 月，雅各布·安德鲁 (Jacob Andreou) 接任。 这位 33 岁的前 Snap 高管现在管理着一个拥有 11,000 名员工的组织，而苏莱曼则在模型开发方面担任了更狭窄的角色。

安德烈欧的框架是暗淡而清晰的。 据 TechCrunch 报道，他在一份内部备忘录中表示，该应用程序必须在客户的生活中赢得“存在的权利”。

新的重点是实际工作和成果。 变色的斑点无法在这句话中幸存下来。

当交接发生时，办公桌将其覆盖，作为人工智能重置而不是重新洗牌。 本周的重置实际上就是这样的。

原来的赌注并不愚蠢。 如果每个助手的回答都大致相同，那么人们选择的就是使用的感觉。

这个推理一直成立，直到你检查是否有人换了。 温暖很难衡量，却很容易被切断。

数字说明了紧迫性

这就是微软试图缩小的差距。 截至 2026 年 7 月，Microsoft 365 Copilot 拥有 3000 万付费席位，这是一项严肃的企业业务。

消费者应用程序则是另一回事。 Sensor Tower 估计每月约有 3850 万用户。

将其与 ChatGPT 相比，每月用户数约为 10 亿。 Gemini 的月用户数也达到了 10 亿，并且桌面上已经介绍了这些数字的计算方式。

微软也很难转化其现有用户，这就是为什么在将助手变为可选功能之前，只有 3.3% 的用户为 Copilot 付费。

对你来说真正的改变是什么

实用的细节值得在周二之前了解。 群聊话题、消息和图像不会传输，因此请先将您想要的任何内容复制到文档中。

在截止日期之前可以单独下载播客。 Deep Research 不再面向消费者账户，而付费专业用户则使用名为 Researcher 的工具。

大多数其他内容在迁移后仍然存在，包括聊天、图像和文件，这些内容都转移到了 OneDrive 中。 工作和学校帐户除了新名称和图标之外几乎看不到任何东西。

一个地址悄然发生变化。 商业方面从 m365.cloud.microsoft 转移到 copilot.cloud.microsoft，并从 8 月底开始进行重定向。

合并只是一个步骤，而不是目的地

Windows 和 Mac 上的应用程序整合将于本周从 Windows Insiders 开始，持续到 9 月中旬。

Satya Nadella 表示，这款超级应用程序将于第三季度末推出，它将聊天、编码、Cowork 和内部称为 Autopilot 的代理工作流程结合在一起。

微软并不是唯一一家将事物整合在一起的公司。 TechCrunch 指出，Anthropic 将 Cowork 合并到 Claude 的聊天中，OpenAI 将 Operator 纳入 ChatGPT，而 Google 将专门的工具纳入 Gemini。

慷慨的阅读是产品纪律。 发布许多小的人工智能功能，然后删除没有人使用的功能，比出于骄傲而让它们继续存在要好。

无论哪种方式，监管机构都在关注捆绑销售。 英国竞争管理机构已经开放了 Microsoft 365 Copilot 调查，并且进一步深入 Office 的单个应用程序并没有让这一切变得更简单。

什么可以解决它

有两件事，而且都不需要吉祥物。 第一个是合并后消费者数量是否移动。

如果应用程序内置 Word、Excel 和 Outlook 后，每月用户数急剧增加到 3850 万，那么该策略就奏效了。 如果不这样做，微软就消除了个性并一无所获。

第二个是超级应用程序的截止日期。 纳德拉已承诺在 9 月底完成，时间已经足够接近，可以进行检查。

与此同时，米科正在教学。 微软表示，这就是角色有成长空间的地方，这是公司在某件事不起作用且没人愿意这么说时写的一句话。
